note: The same radio as uv5rmini-5RMINI.bin, read over Bluetooth instead of the cable. Every channel byte matches the cable read; the two images differ only in three bytes of the 0x9000 settings block - activeVfo, an unmodelled byte at 0x901A, and the bluetooth flag itself, which is set precisely because the radio was in wireless CPS mode for this read and on a cable for the other. Nothing personal in it: the printable-string scan over all 33,344 bytes finds no run of four characters.
